source._comment: STAGED SKELETON, re-checked 2026-10-14 (Oct rollout routine) -- still no feed. Confirmed general-election early voting begins 2026-10-19 (sos.arkansas.gov/uploads/elections/2026_Election_Calendar_Rev._6-2025_.pdf, Ark. Code 7-5-418(a)(1)(A)). Checked sos.arkansas.gov/elections and its voter-information/absentee-voting/research/election-results subpages: no early-voting-in-progress county dashboard or CSV/XLSX exists -- the 'research/election-results' files are post-election certified results (XLS), not live early-vote counts. By statute (Ark. Code 7-5-416(a)(7)(B), 7-5-701) county boards report early/absentee counts to the SOS only AFTER polls close on election day, not during the EV period, so there is no state-level daily feed to parse even once voting starts -- only individual county clerks post their own early-vote PDFs ad hoc (e.g. Pulaski, Crawford counties), with no common format or index to aggregate centrally. UF Election Lab's AR row (election.lab.ufl.edu/data-downloads/earlyvote/2026/US.csv) is also still all-zero/stale (last_update 8/12/2026) as of this check. Re-check after Nov 3 for a possible post-election county certified-results file, or re-check sos.arkansas.gov/elections and the Lab CSV once EV opens (2026-10-19) in case a dashboard appears. Reads 0 until then.
